integrity.claim_scope: finite Fourier degree-four convex support class
integrity.proof_basis: exact support-function Fourier algebra and a degree-two nonnegative trigonometric-polynomial factorization
integrity.source_date_basis: 2015-06-19 is the accepted/published-online date printed in the public article preview for DOI:10.3906/mat-1504-12; it is used instead of the later final journal version date.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to support functions of Fourier degree at most four and does not solve the unrestricted constant 3-order-width least-area problem.
The equality body's radius-of-curvature density has isolated zeros; in the everywhere-positive-curvature subclass the same constant is a sharp infimum rather than an attained minimum.

A 2015 characterization paper on constant k-order width was only available through abstract-level material during the comparison, and a 2023 reverse-Chernoff paper was available through a publisher preview; these are retained originality risks.
title: Sharp degree-four Fourier cutoff for constant 3-order width
